summary: Five churches. Weekend and weekday Masses, and the first-Friday Adoration at St. Bernard's, are in the newest schedule box. Tuesday 5:30 PM Holy Hour with Confession rotates between three churches by week of the month, taken from the parish website and matched against four bulletin calendars. Oct 27-29 Masses are replaced by Communion Services (cancellations recorded). Open: whether the stale-looking Colgate page's Sunday confession counts.
